claim_text: Asked at Joint Base Andrews on Tuesday, 11 August 2026, whether he was serious about seeking a third term, Trump said: "And you know that the law is very strong on that. I'd love to run, but the law is very strong," then ignored a reporter's attempt to press further.
quote: “Everybody asks me that question,” he said. “And you know that the law is very strong on that. I’d love to run, but the law is very strong.”
